inherited_mathematical_inputs: The D125 fixed-mass original-residual certificate is independent of seed and iteration history.
Original contracting transports, weighted error lattice, integral low inverse, direct CM and truncation estimates retain their prior proofs and hashes.
All D125 finite quadric enclosures and exact-zero prerequisites remain unchanged.

An existing factor modulo 2^m solves the original low system modulo 2^(2m) with two lower-precision solves and exact division of the higher-precision residual by 2^m; every final original sparse equation is checked.
certificate_boundaries: Fourteen outputs are encoded one state at a time and compared directly with retained D124 bytes; no new binary file writer or refinement is executed.
Assembly consumes prior verified original-map chunks and retains their arithmetic certification; it does not recompute those maps.
Preparation controls rebuild all sparse low equations and compare complete new weighted states/corrections against known answers.
The P=3200 extension inputs come from actual P=1600 moments with exact masses; full and low-RHS inputs are synthetic.
Only eighteen of 174 states are sampled in each mode; no full P=3200 coverage, actual harmonic refinement or complete runtime bound is inferred.
The new byte inventory is prospective and is not an enforced cap or RAM bound.
Finite implementation controls preserve rather than replace the prior independent mathematical audit.
